title: Tiered Armor
description: This datapack completely overhauls how you obtain gear and gives a new purpose to Rotten Flesh. You can no longer craft high-tier armor from scratch—you must evolve your gear piece by piece.
body:
## Important ⚠️
This datapack was created as an integral part of my beta-like [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/scenery). Please take a look at it
## Features 
Rotten Flesh Utility:
- Rotten Flesh is no longer trash. Use it to craft Leather.
- Leather can now be used to craft Beds and basic Leather Armor.

Sequential Armor Progression:
To get better gear, you must upgrade your existing pieces in a crafting table:
- Leather → Iron: Surround leather armor with iron ingots.
- Iron → Gold: Upgrade iron pieces using gold ingots.
- Gold → Diamond: Finally, use diamonds to reach the diamond tier.

## Why is it useful
- True Progression: No more skipping tiers. You must start from the bottom.
- Resource Sink: Every material matters, from rotten flesh to gold.
- Balanced Early Game: Makes leather production viable through zombie hunting.
